content: Table stakes for endpoint DLP in 2024-2025 include: data discovery and classification, endpoint channel enforcement across USB, clipboard, print, browser, email, cloud uploads, and network shares, content inspection via regex/patterns/fingerprints, centralized policy management, incident response with blocking/warning/quarantine, offline enforcement, and audit logging/reporting. Differentiators include AI/ML-based classification, behavioral analytics/UEBA, risk-adaptive policies, EDR/XDR integration, and agentless discovery.
